page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1ne.4xlarge is a memory-optimized cloud server instance configured with 16 vCPUs derived from 8 physical cores on an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. Built on the x86_64 architecture with KVM hypervisor management, the system includes 128.0 GB of RAM, yielding an 8.0 GB memory-to-vCPU ratio. CPU instruction extensions include AVX, AVX-512F, AES, BMI2, ADX, and FMA, alongside 35 MB of L3 cache. The instance does not bundle local NVMe or SSD storage, requiring attached network storage for disk operations, and includes zero GPU accelerators. Network connectivity provides a 3 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

Benchmark data displays a contrast between single-core performance and multi-core throughput. Single-core tests show constrained capabilities, reflected by a Geekbench single-core score of 893.0 and single-threaded Gzip compression of 19.01 GB/sec. Multi-core performance aligns with average platform norms, achieving a Geekbench multi-core score of 5757.0 and a PassMark CPU score of 13025.11. Memory bandwidth tests demonstrate 75.3 GB/sec uncached read and 53.85 GB/sec uncached write performance, while PassMark memory scoring registers in the lower tier relative to modern cloud hardware.

The 8.0 GB per vCPU memory capacity offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-intensive workloads that do not demand top-tier single-threaded CPU performance. Application-layer benchmarks demonstrate stable operation under load, processing 11.19 million Redis SET operations per second and 7.73 GB/sec in static web serving tests. High memory density makes this instance well suited for in-memory databases, key-value caching clusters, software compilation pipelines, and light-to-medium text processing tasks.
